mechanism: Fluphenazine may increase photosensitivity risk, and vitamin D metabolism can be affected by antipsychotic-induced movement disorders and reduced sun exposure; fluphenazine may also have minor effects on calcium-phosphate homeostasis relevant to vitamin D function.
action: Monitor vitamin D levels periodically; counsel patient on sun protection; ensure adequate dietary calcium and vitamin D intake, particularly if patient has reduced outdoor exposure due to medication side effects.
